messages.subject: Re: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
messages.subject_clean: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kate,

This is a good idea: it would be useful to get warnings from models that terminate normally, but with potentially dubious results. I'll put this on my to do list. The main problem, I think, will be to track down whether these messages are printed out in a consistent position and format in the output files. My experience is that they're usually just below the "terminated normally" message, so I look there.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: createModels does not run on mac (but on PC)
messages.subject_clean: createModels does not run on mac (but on PC)
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ylva,

Sorry, I apparently introduced a bug in the v0.5-4 update that broke the createModels function. This has now been fixed. You can get the current development version (with the fix) using:

install.packages("devtools")
require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")

Let me know if this doesn't fix the issue for you.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I have refactored the divideIntoFields code to be tolerant of not using IS/ARE/=. I think this change will fix any of the related issues that have come up. The change is committed to Github, so you can obtain the fix using:

install.packages("devtools")
require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")

Let me know if you have any further problems with divideIntoFields.

Best,
Michael

On Thursday, March 21, 2013 6:58:03 AM UTC-4, Caspar van Lissa wrote:

> >
> > Glad to hear it.  I think that Mplus is pretty lax about not requiring
> > ARE/IS/=, but that is how the MplusAutomation package knows the
> > section versus input.  Unforunately, Mplus does not return output in a
> > single structured form, so to get it into R, we must parse the text
> > file based on certain rules, such as commands to the left of certain
> > delimitters, variables, input, etc. on the right.
> >
> > Cheers,
> >
> > Josh

> > > "lrstarts =" I just have "lrstarts 0 0 100 25".  The mplus programs runs ok
> > > and the extract model summaries has always previously worked without the =
> > > sign.  I'll just change all my input and output code.

> > > Thanks again
> > >
> > > Frances

> > >
> > > On Tue, Feb 19, 2013 at 1:00 PM, Joshua Wiley <jwiley...@gmail.com>

> > >> lrtstarts = 0 0 100 25
> > >>
> > >> because the package parses left and right hand side by the Mplus
